name: e2e machine
description: A provisioner for the end-to-end tests, with no provider behind it: it records the machine, and the seed rookery renders is never handed anywhere.

provisioners.label: e2e machine
provisioners.description: Records a machine and renders the seed rookery would hand a provider. The stack runs no provider, so nothing is started and the machine has no address.

arguments.name: flavor
arguments.label: Flavor
arguments.help: A made-up flavor of the machine, which the test profile carries through.

kinds.label: Machine
kinds.description: A machine record with a rendered seed, which no provider has made.

arguments.name: cpus
arguments.label: CPUs
arguments.help: How many CPUs the machine is recorded with.

arguments.name: memory
arguments.label: Memory
arguments.help: How much memory it is recorded with, such as 2GiB.

arguments.name: disk
arguments.label: Disk size
arguments.help: The size of its root disk, such as 20GiB.

arguments.name: image
arguments.label: Image
arguments.help: The image the record names, which no provider fetches.
